item.title: Poet Kannadasan: a creative mind that enriched Tamil cinema with exquisite, philosophical songs
item.description: Kannadasan, whose birth centenary is being celebrated, was born as Muthaiah at Sirukoodalpatti in present day Sivaganga district. An atheist in his early years while active in the Dravidian movement, the Tamil poet later turned spiritual.

item.title: ‘He should better visit Bihar’: Minister takes a dig at Chirag Paswan over his remarks against State govt.
item.description: Bihar Minister and BJP leader Lakhendra Paswan, reacting to Chirag Paswan’s remarks over rising crime against women, suggested the Union minister to directly hold talks with the NDA-led State government

item.title: Beyond Fort St. George: Tamil Nadu government’s quest for an Assembly-Secretariat site is more than a century old
item.description: Somehow, the Fort had such an appeal that the legislature kept coming back to the historic 17th-century vestige of the colonial era

item.title: The 1981 byelection that triggered twists and turns in Tamil Nadu politics
item.description: There is an ongoing litigation in the Madras High Court over the election results in the Tirupattur Assembly constituency, where the ruling TVK candidate was declared elected by just one vote. Interestingly, 40 years ago, Tirupattur hogged the limelight, even at the national level, for strange reasons

item.title: ‘Dorothy’, a long-awaited embrace for the queer community

item.title: Lessons from the history of rebellions in AIADMK and DMK in Tamil Nadu
item.description: With discomfort in the AIADMK showing no signs of subsiding, after former School Education Minister and veteran leader K.A. Sengottaiyan was divested of party posts following his call for the return of estranged leaders, it is a timely moment to revisit some of the most significant uprisings within Tamil Nadu’s two major Dravidian parties

item.title: Sensex rises 190 points in early trade after two days of losses

item.title: Senior journalist seeks to intervene in legislative privilege versus free speech case

item.title: Why rare-disease drugs could become India’s next pharma frontier
item.description: Since India has already shown the world how to make drugs affordable, the next challenge is to show the world how to make rare-disease drugs accessible; with a streamlined regulatory pathway, appropriate financial incentives, and government procurement, India could build a globally competitive rare-disease pharmaceutical sector

item.title: Mammoth protest at Kittur Chennamma Circle by Sugarcane farmers; Farmers agree for talk at Delhi with Joshi after intervention by MLAs Tenginakai, Patil
item.description: Thousands of sugarcane growers from across Karnataka and neighbouring Maharashtra and Telangana staged a massive protest at Kittur Chennamma Circle in Hubballi on Tuesday, demanding remunerative prices for sugarcane and a revision of the minimum selling price (MSP) of sugar. After appeal by union minister Pralhad Joshi, intervention by local legislators they agree for talks at Delhi, withdraw protest

item.title: At the Chettinad Heritage and Cultural Festival, a revival takes root
item.description: The Chettinad Heritage and Cultural Festival offers a glimpse of a wider revival, driven by people such as Meenakshi Meyyappan, revivalist Visalakshi Ramaswamy and architect Benny Kuriakose who are finding new ways to preserve, reinvent and draw attention to the region’s architecture, crafts and traditions
